title: Manager Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) & Internal Controls Oversight
category: Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, Telecommunication, Business Administration, Risk Management
description:
Role Summary
To lead the establishment, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework across Etisalat Afghanistan by providing independent risk oversight, challenge, monitoring, reporting, and advisory support to promote effective management of risks within the approved risk appetite. The role serves as a second-line risk oversight function, promoting a strong risk culture and informed decision-making. In addition, the role provides independent oversight of the Internal Controls Framework and coordinates and monitors risk-based control review, testing, and remediation activities in alignment with Etisalat Group requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide risk identification, assessment, evaluation, monitoring, and reporting activities covering strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, technology, business continuity, and reputational risks.
• Facilitate periodic risk assessments and Risk C Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) across business functions to identify emerging risks, assess control effectiveness, and evaluate residual risk exposure.
• Maintain the Enterprise Risk Register, ensuring significant risks are appropriately documented, assessed, assigned to risk owners, and supported by mitigation plans.
• Develop, maintain, and monitor risk appetite statements, risk tolerance thresholds, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Key Control Indicators (KCIs), and escalate significant breaches and exposures to management.
• Facilitate and oversee the documentation and periodic review of risks, controls, control ownership, testing procedures, and remediation plans for critical business processes.
• Coordinate and oversee the annual Internal Controls Review and Testing Program to assess the design adequacy and operating effectiveness of key controls.
• Identify control deficiencies, process weaknesses, and governance gaps through risk and control assessments, and provide independent recommendations to management to strengthen the effectiveness of the control environment.
• Monitor and report the implementation status of risk mitigation actions, control remediation plans, and risk-related recommendations arising from Internal Audit, External Audit, regulatory reviews, and management assessments.
• Prepare and present periodic risk and internal control reports to the VP Risk C Assurance, Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC), and the Audit C Risk Management Committee (ARMC), highlighting key risk exposures, emerging risks, control weaknesses, trends, and mitigation progress.
• Collaborate with Internal Audit, Compliance, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, Information Security, Finance, Technology, Human Resources, and business functions to enhance enterprise-wide risk and control management practices.
• Act as Secretary to the Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC) chaired by the CEO by coordinating meetings, preparing agendas and risk reports, recording minutes, tracking action items, and facilitating timely closure of agreed actions.
• Assess and monitor regulatory and compliance risks and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to support adherence to telecommunications regulations, license obligations, corporate policies, and applicable laws.
• Provide independent oversight of Business Continuity Management (BCM) and Disaster Recovery (DR) testing exercises and monitor implementation of agreed improvement actions.
• Evaluate cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, technology, and network resilience risks in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and ensure such risks are appropriately reflected in the Enterprise Risk Register.
• Provide risk advisory support for strategic initiatives, major projects, investments, new products, digital transformation programs, outsourcing arrangements, and other significant business decisions.
• Promote a strong risk-aware and control-conscious culture through communication, training, awareness initiatives, and stakeholder engagement activities.
• Monitor industry trends, emerging risks, geopolitical developments, regulatory changes, and market conditions that may impact Etisalat Afghanistan's objectives and operations.

Job Requirements
Educational Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Telecommunications and Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Preferred:
• Master’s degree in risk management
• Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP)
• Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA)
• Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
• Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
• ISO 31000 Risk Management Certification
Experience Requirements:
• Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Controls, Compliance, Governance, Risk Advisory, or related disciplines.
• Substantial hands-on experience in Enterprise Risk Management is essential. Experience in Internal Controls, Internal Audit, Compliance, Governance, or Assurance may be considered as complementary experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in a managerial or leadership role - preferred.
• Experience within telecommunications, technology, financial services, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
• Demonstrated experience in implementing and maintaining Enterprise Risk Management and Internal Control Frameworks.
• Experience in facilitating senior management and Board-level committees and preparing executive and Board reports.
• Strong understanding of risk management frameworks, internal controls, governance, regulatory compliance, business continuity, and operational resilience.
Technical Competencies:
• Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
• Internal Control Frameworks (COSO)
• ISO 31000 Risk Management
• Governance, Risk C Compliance (GRC)
• Risk Assessment and Analysis
• Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA)
• Internal Controls Testing and Evaluation
• Regulatory Compliance Management
• Operational Risk Management
• Cybersecurity and Technology Risk Management
• Data Analytics and Risk Reporting
• KRI and KCI Development
Behavioral Competencies:
• Strategic Thinking
• Leadership and Stakeholder Management
• Analytical and Critical Thinking
• Decision Making and Problem Solving
• Communication and Presentation Skills
• Influencing and Negotiation Skills
• Planning and Organizing
• Collaboration and Teamwork
• Change Management
• Business Acumen
• Integrity and Professional Ethics
• Results Orientation
• Resilience and Adaptability

Kindly use the Google Chrome Browser for smooth access.
For further information, please contact us via WhatsApp at +93 (0) 788 887 363.

BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:
The World Food Programme (WFP) is the world's largest humanitarian agency, fighting hunger worldwide. Over the years, WFP has made available its supply chain expertise, knowledge and network to governments, donors and UN agencies as a global good. The Data Scientist position will contribute to strengthening the evidence agenda of the Country Office through innovative analysis, including the development and training of artificial intelligence models tailored to food security and vulnerability, thereby enhancing the efficiency of VAM analysis and enabling more precise programme design and targeting

 In collaboration with VAME GIS officer, Support the periodic updates, maintenance of the VAME geospatial visualization platform (AF Pulse), which integrates data from programme, assessment, monitoring, security, operations and supply chain with data collection, standardization and upload;
 Design, calibrate, and operationalize a probability model that estimates the likelihood of road disruption in proximity to conflict events.
 Update, validate, calibrate and operationalize a probability model that estimates acute malnutrition levels using acute malnutrition admission data and other related variables.
 Intergrade automated models into AF Pulse to strengthen the real-time disaster impacts and exposure analysis.
 Propose a replication and scale‑up roadmap, documenting migration pathways to alternative cloud environments, producing an open‑source replication toolkit, and identifying priority countries for adaptation of the model.
 Develop, test and refine geographical-level targeting criteria and models for emergency assistance, resilience, livelihoods and social protection interventions and geographical and beneficiary targeting to ensure maximum efficiency and equity in resource allocation, minimizing geographical bias.
 Coordinate and provide technical analysis, recommendations and learnings to continuously improve the early warning workstream.
 Other tasks as required by the VAME related to Early Warning Analysis and Systems.

Bachelor’s degree in social science, economics, statistics, food security, GIS, data science, or other relevant subjects. Master’s degree would be an advantage.

Minimum 3 years of experience in research, data analysis, modelling including AI model training, needs assessments, and/or data and geo-spatial visualization.

• Proven skills and experience in planning and facilitating training.

title: Internal Audit Senior Officer (IT)
description:
Role Summary
The Internal Audit Senior Officer (IT) is responsible for conducting internal audits and pre-audit compliance reviews to ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, applicable laws, and internal control systems. The incumbent initiates, designs, and develops internal audit programs aimed at protecting the company’s assets and resources. He/she is responsible for the investigation of irregularities and recommends improvements to practices, structures, and procedures.

Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in developing and executing the annual internal audit plan and assess compliance with AWCC policies and procedures and management directives.
Conduct risk-based IT audits.
Review and assess IT systems, infrastructure, and applications.
Evaluate internal controls over Access Management, Cybersecurity, System changes, backup, and disaster recovery.
Evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls and risk management processes.
Identify weaknesses and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare audit working papers and draft audit reports.
Follow up on implementation of audit recommendations.
Assist in identifying operational, financial, and IT-related risks.
Ensure proper documentation and filing of audit evidence.
Participate in stock counts and asset verification.
Review payment vouchers, purchase orders, contracts, and other transactions before approval.
Verify accuracy, completeness, authorization, and supporting documentation.
Ensure compliance with procurement policies and delegation of authority.
Identify and prevent potential irregularities before transactions are finalized.
Recommend correction or rejection of non-compliant transactions.
Ensure that the requested costs are in accordance with audit/procurement policy and do not exceed the normal market rate.

Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science; a Master's degree is preferable. (CCNA certificate is an asset)
Good knowledge of telecommunications laws, rules, and regulations.
At least 3-4 years of related experience in the Audit & IT Department.
Fluent communication skills (written and verbal) in local languages as well as English.
Professional training or certificates in IT & Audit-related fields are a plus.
Understanding of multiple technology domains, including software development, Windows, Database Management, and Networking.
Capable of working independently and with minimal supervision.
Able to travel to all provinces of Afghanistan.
Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills; ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
Expert knowledge of internal auditing, internal controls, and risk management.
Comprehensive understanding of internal control environments within the IT function.
Excellent leadership and teamwork skills.
Proactive, hands-on, results-driven orientation required.

description:
Role Summary
Provide senior-level technical expertise in applied research, engineering assessment and development of practical solutions for DABS power generation, transmission and distribution systems. The position identifies opportunities to improve network reliability, operational efficiency, safety and technology adoption, and translates research findings into technically justified recommendations for management and relevant operational departments

Duties and Responsibilities
Power Systems Research and Engineering Analysis
Conduct applied technical studies on electricity generation, transmission, distribution and grid integration, prioritizing operational needs identified by DABS
Analyze network performance, technical losses, reliability, power quality, equipment performance and system constraints; identify feasible improvement measures
Evaluate relevant engineering designs, technical specifications, study reports and proposed technologies, and provide evidence-based technical opinions within the assigned mandate
Use appropriate engineering calculations, modelling and simulation tools to assess alternatives, document assumptions and validate study results
Technology Development and Innovation
Assess emerging technologies, including grid automation, SCADA applications, smart-grid solutions, energy storage and renewable-energy integration, for their technical suitability and implementation feasibility
Identify opportunities to improve the design, specification, testing, maintenance and, where relevant, local production or assembly of electrical equipment
Prepare technical concepts, pilot-study proposals, test plans and evaluation criteria for proposed innovations in coordination with responsible departments
Assess prototype or pilot results and recommend whether solutions should be refined, scaled up or discontinued
Technical Studies and Implementation Support
Prepare feasibility assessments and technical comparisons covering performance, cost implications, risks, safety, maintainability and implementation requirements
Develop study scopes, work plans, technical deliverables and progress updates for assigned research activities
Provide technical support to Operations, Planning and other relevant departments in evaluating research findings and potential field applications
Identify applicable technical standards, regulatory requirements and DABS specifications, and document compliance considerations in recommendations
Coordination, Reporting and Knowledge Transfer
Coordinate with internal technical units, equipment suppliers, research institutions and other approved partners to collect data, review findings and facilitate knowledge transfer
Prepare clear technical reports, engineering recommendations, presentations and decision-support briefs for the Director of Research and Development and senior management
Maintain organized research records, calculations, models, test evidence and lessons learned to support traceability and future use
Share technical knowledge through briefings, workshops and practical guidance to relevant DABS personnel as requested
Expected Deliverables
Approved work plans and periodic progress reports for assigned technical studies
Technical assessment reports, feasibility studies, engineering analyses and documented recommendations
Technology or pilot evaluation reports, including findings, risks and proposed next steps
Technical presentations and knowledge-sharing materials for relevant stakeholders

Job Requirements
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering
Minimum five years of relevant professional experience in power systems engineering, applied research, technical studies or technology development, preferably involving utility transmission and/or distribution systems
Strong knowledge of power-system operation, planning, reliability, protection and relevant engineering standards
Ability to conduct engineering calculations and use relevant power-system analysis or simulation software
Working knowledge of SCADA, grid automation, power electronics and emerging grid technologies
Ability to evaluate technical alternatives, prepare feasibility studies and communicate evidence-based recommendations
Strong analytical, coordination, report-writing and documentation skills
Effective communication in English and applicable national languages

title: Product Engineer (PM)
description:
Location: Fully Remote
Compensation: $23.08 to $34.62 USD/hour
Benefits: 15 days PTO. Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid off.
Fair warning: the pace is intense and the ambiguity is real. But you'll feel yourself growing every single week, even the rough ones, and you'll be doing it next to people who actually celebrate your wins and have your back.
We're the all-in-one agentic marketing platform. AI-native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.
We're looking for a Product Engineer to own a pod's output end-to-end: strategy, specs, QA, and enough technical depth to unblock engineers or write the code yourself when that's the fastest path forward. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If you've been waiting for a PM role that doesn't ask you to leave your technical background at the door, this is it.
What you'll own
Own the roadmap for your pod: define what gets built, kill low-leverage work, and protect your engineers' time and focus
Write specs that start with the problem, not the solution, and ship every brief with a clear success criterion
Participate technically: read the codebase, debug independently, and ship small things when it's faster than context-switching an engineer
Own QA end-to-end: test plans, regression passes, release sign-off, and post-deploy monitoring in Sentry and Grafana
Keep the pod moving: fast decisions, async-first communication, and zero ambiguity about what's next
Close the feedback loop between customers, data, and product direction, and hold yourself accountable to the KPIs you define
You'll thrive here if...
You've shipped production code before and you're honest with yourself about your technical depth
You treat a spec as a hypothesis to pressure-test, not a document to execute against
You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.
Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.
You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."
You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.
You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.
You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.
What we're looking for
3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, startup or high-growth environment
A hands-on technical background: production code, a bootcamp, or demonstrable ability to navigate a full-stack codebase
Comfortable reading Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; able to write SQL, reason about REST contracts, and follow frontend state
Proven QA ownership: test cases, regression cycles, structured bug reports, release sign-off
Daily fluency with Claude Code or equivalent. Not "open to it." Actually using it.
Strong written communication. Your specs are clear and complete on the first read.
Available in EST
What working here actually looks like
High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.
The boundary between product and engineering is intentionally blurred here. The best product decisions are inseparable from technical reality, and we hire people who understand that.
We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.
We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.
What we stand for
We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us
We figure it the f**k out
We go to war on our problems quickly
We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.
We're fun AF
About Search Atlas
Search Atlas helps marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're a $30M+ ARR company, 215 people, bootstrapped, and building the infrastructure for the next era of marketing. No outside funding. No fluff. Just product.

title: 283 - کارشناس ارشد عملیاتی شبکه
location: Kabul - ریاست سیستم های مالی افغانستان
description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه: انکشاف،‌ تقویه و ایجاد پالیسی ها بمنظور نگهداشتن شبکه از خطرات بیرونی و داخلی

Job Requirements
صلاحیت و مسئولیت های وظیفوی:
وظایف تخصصی :
نصب، عیارسازی، پیکربندی و نگهداری تجهیزات شبکه Cisco Router, Switches, Firewall.
طرح و تطبیق پالیسی‌های امنیتی جهت محافظت از شبکه در برابر تهدیدات داخلی و خارجی و دسترسی‌های غیرمجاز
نظارت از عملکرد شبکه و تجهیزات، تهیه و نگهداری نسخه‌های احتیاطی (Backup) مدیریت و نظارت بر Disaster Recovery (DR) Site و همکاری در تطبیق پلان‌های ، Recovery (BCDR). Business Continuity and Disaster
تنظیم و مدیریت تجهیزات سیسکو و پروتوکول‌های مسیریابی، از جمله Routing Protocols, Swtching protocols
تنظیم و مدیریت ارتباطات بین شبکه‌های داخلی، مراکز معلومات، شعبات و سیستم‌های بیرونی از طریق VPN, IPsec, Routing and Switching..
نظارت و تحلیل عملکرد شبکه و دیتاسنتر از طریق سیستم‌های Network Monitoring, Performance Monitoring and Troubleshooting
مدیریت، نظارت و نگهداری زیربناهای Data Center سیستم AFMIS ، شامل Servers, Storage Systems, Virtualization Platforms, و Racks تجهیزات شبکه‌ای مربوطه .
حصول اطمینان از ارائه خدمات Lease line برای واحد های بودیجوی و مستوفیت ها
تدویر برنامه‌های آموزشی برای کارمندان جهت استفاده صحیح و مؤثر از تجهیزات و خدمات تکنالوژی معلوماتی .
ترتیب پروپوزل‌ها و مشخصات تخنیکی معیاری برای پروژه‌های توسعه و ارتقای تکنالوژی معلوماتی در مرکز و ولایات .
نظارت بر نصب و تطبیق به‌روزرسانی‌های امنیتی ( Security Patches) و نسخه‌های اصلاحی Firmware تجهیزات شبکه و فایروال‌ها، هماهنگی برای انجام آزمایش‌های لازم پیش از تطبیق و تهیه پلان بازگشت به وضعیت قبلی در صورت بروز مشکل.
نظارت و تحلیل رویدادها و لاگ‌های امنیتی شبکه، بررسی فعالیت‌های مشکوک، شناسایی آسیب‌پذیری‌های امنیتی و هماهنگی با بخش امنیت سایبری جهت رسیدگی به حوادث امنیتی و اتخاذ اقدامات اصلاحی لازم
ه مکاری در تطبیق و نظارت بر تفکیک منطقی شبکه از طریق VLAN ، Access Control Lists (ACLs) و سایر میکانیزم‌های کنترولی، به‌منظور محدودسازی دسترسی میان شبکه‌های کاربران، سرورها، مدیریت تجهیزات و سیستم‌های حساس
حصول اطمینان از ثبت و بررسی تغییرات پیکربندی تجهیزات شبکه و امنیتی، نگهداری نسخه‌های احتیاطی تنظیمات ( Configuration Backups) و آزمایش امکان بازیابی آن‌ها مطابق طرزالعمل‌های منظورشده.
اجرای سایر وظایف مرتبط به رشته تخصصی که از طرف مقامات ذیصلاح مطابق قوانین و مقررات نافذ به وی سپرده می‌شود

تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی اداره جهت بدست آوردن اهداف تعیین شده اداره.
ارایه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه و عند الضرورت از فعالیتها و دست آوردهای بخش مربوطه به منظور مطلع ساختن رهبری .

title: 284 - کارشناس ارشد سیستم و مجازی سازی
location: Kabul - ریاست سیستم های مالی افغانستان
description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه: کمک با ادارات و مسؤلین امارتی در مورد عملیات های فنی سیستم معلوماتی مالی امارت جهت حل مشکلات تخنیکی

Job Requirements
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف تخصصی:
نصب، پیکربندی و نگهداری سیستم‌عامل‌ها ( Windows Server ، Linux )
مدیریت Active Directory ، DNS ، DHCP ، Group Policy
مدیریت کاربران، دسترسی‌ها و سطح امنیت
مانیتورینگ عملکرد سرورها و رفع مشکلات ( Troubleshooting )
پیاده‌سازی و مدیریت Backup و Restore و مدیریت Storage و File Server
طراحی و پیاده‌سازی زیرساخت مجازی‌سازی ( VMware ESXi, Vcenter ، Hyper-V )
ساخت، تنظیم و مدیریت Virtual Machines (VMs) .
مدیریت Resource ها ( CPU ، RAM ، Storage ).
پیاده‌سازی High Availability (HA) و Failover .
مانیتورینگ زیرساخت مجازی‌سازی .
تطبیق به ‌روزرسانی ‌ها و وصله‌های امنیتی (Security Patches) برای سیستم‌عامل‌ها، نرم‌افزارهای زیرساختی و پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی، مطابق با طرزالعمل‌های تأییدشده .
طراحی و تطبیق راهکارهای افزونگی (Redundancy) و تحمل خطا (Fault Tolerance) برای کاهش خطر توقف خدمات و افزایش پایداری زیرساخت .
تشخیص و رفع مشکلات پیچیده سیستم‌عامل‌ها، سرویس‌های زیرساختی، ماشین‌های مجازی و منابع ذخیره‌سازی، با استفاده از ابزارهای تشخیصی و تحلیل لاگ‌ها .
مدیریت امنیت Active Directory و Domain Controllers: تطبیق تنظیمات امنیتی برای Active Directory ، Domain Controllers ، Group Policy و حساب‌های کاربری؛ شناسایی و رفع تنظیمات نادرست، حساب‌های غیرفعال، مجوزهای غیرضروری و ضعف‌های امنیتی مرتبط با احراز هویت و مدیریت هوی
تأمین امنیت پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی: تطبیق تنظیمات امنیتی در VMware ESXi ، vCenter و Hyper-V ، محدودسازی دسترسی مدیریتی، جداسازی شبکه‌های مدیریتی، محافظت از رابط‌های مدیریتی و بررسی دوره‌ای تنظیمات امنیتی مطابق با معیارهای تأییدشده .
مدیریت امنیت لاگ‌ها و ثبت رویدادها ( Logging and Auditing): فعال‌سازی و تنظیم ثبت رویدادهای امنیتی در سیستم‌عامل‌ها، Active Directory ، سرورها و پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی؛ تأمین نگهداری امن لاگ‌ها، جلوگیری از دست‌کاری غیرمجاز.
مدیریت امنیت حساب‌های خدماتی و ارتباطات سیستمی ( Service Accounts): شناسایی و مستندسازی حساب‌های خدماتی، محدودسازی امتیازات آن‌ها، جلوگیری از استفاده غیرضروری از حساب‌های دارای دسترسی ممتاز، مدیریت امن رمزهای عبور و بررسی دوره‌ای مجوزها و فعالیت‌های این حساب‌ها.
وظایف مدیریتی:
تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی ریاست عمومی خزاین ، بمنظور رسیدن به اهداف ت عیین شده اداره.
ارائه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار، سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های آمریت مربوطه، به منظور مطلع ساختن رهبری وزارت.
اجرای سایر وظایف که از طرف آمر مربوطه مطابق قوانین، مقررات و اهداف وزارت مربوطه سپرده میشود.
وظایف هماهنگی:
تامین ارتباط و هماهنگی با تمام بخش های ذیربط جهت انسجام و پیشبرد بهتر امور.
تحکیم ارتباط با کلیه بخش ادارات مربوط جهت تقویه و انکشاف نرم افزار و سایر سیستم های مالی.
حل چالش ها و مشکلات بخش های مربوطه به سیستم های مالی و کمپیوتری.
شرایط استخدام:
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد
سن وی از (۱۸) سال کمتر و از (۶۴) بیشتر نباشد.
سویه تحصیلی:
داشتن سند تحصیلی حد اقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته های کمپیوتر ساینس، تکنالوژی معلوماتی ، و سیستم های معلوماتی و یا معادل آن داخل یا خارج کشور که به تائید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد.
تجربه کاری:
تجربه کاری حد اقل ۳ سال مرتبط و ظیفه
مهارت‌های لازم:
توانایی رهنمایی و کنترول بخش مربوطه.
قابلیت طرح و تعیین خط مشی (پالیسی) اداره/ وزارت مربوطه.
تسلط به زبان‌های رسمی (پشتو ، دری) و آشنایی (تحریر و تکلم) با زبان انگلیسی.

Submission Guideline
علاقمندان واجد شرایط می توانند که سی وی و درخواستی خویش را در یک فایل پی دی اف به ایمیل ادرس ذیل ارسال نمایند
نوت: لطف نموده درعنوان ایمیل خود نام بست و یا کود نمبر آنرا بنویسید ضم کردن اسناد تحصیلی، تجارب کاری و غیره فعلاً

description:
Role Summary
کارمند بست متذکره مسوول پیشبرد وظایف ذیل می باشد

Duties and Responsibilities
نصب سرور/ نرم افزار ها و نظارت بر عملکرد ها و رفع مشکلات بخش های مربوطه

title: 286 - کارشناس ارشد توسعه نرم افزار
location: Kabul - ریاست سیستم های مالی افغانستان
description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه:
طراحی و توسعه سیستم‌ های نرم ‌افزاری مالی به منظور افزایش کارایی سیستم ها، ایجاد راهکارهای تخنیکی معیاری، پایدار و قابل اعتماد برای حمایت از فعالیت ‌های مالی اداره.

Job Requirements
صلاحیت و مسئولیت های وظیفوی:
وظایف تخصصی:
طراحی، انکشاف و توسعه سیستم ‌ها و اپلیکیشن ‌های نرم افزاری جدید مطابق نیازمندی ‌های اداره.
طراحی ساختار و اجزای تخنیکی نرم‌ افزار مطابق معیارهای توسعه
برنامه ‌نویسی و نوشتن کُدهای معیاری برای انکشاف و توسعه سیستم‌ها با استفاده از زبان‌هایی مانند C# ، .NET Core ، Java و تکنالوژی‌های مرتبط.
طراحی و توسعه رابط‌های برنامه ‌نویسی ( API ) برای اتصال سیستم‌ ها و سرویس‌های داخلی و خارجی.
تحلیل نیازمندی ‌های تخنیکی و تجارتی سیستم ‌ها و ارائه راهکارهای نرم ‌افزاری قابل تطبیق.
انجام آزمایشات نرم ‌افزاری جهت اطمینان از کیفیت و کارکرد درست سیستم‌ ها.
تهیه، به ‌روزرسانی و نگهداری اسناد تخنیکی سیستم‌ ها.
رعایت و تطبیق معیارها، رهنمود ها و بهترین شیوه‌ های توسعه نرم‌ افزار در تمام مراحل انکشاف سیستم.
تشخیص و رفع مشکلات تخنیکی سیستم ‌ها در جریان توسعه و بهره برداری.
همکاری تخنیکی با اعضای تیم توسعه، طراحان و تیم تطبیق در جریان پیاده‌ سازی سیستم ‌ها.
اشتراک در بازبینی کُدها ( Code Review ) و ارائه پیشنهادات تخنیکی جهت بهبود کیفیت توسعه.
همکاری تخنیکی با تیم ‌های تحلیل، تطبیق و نگهداری سیستم‌ ها .
انتقال مهارت ‌ها و تجارب تخنیکی به همکاران در جریان کار .
انجام سایر وظایف مرتبط با توسعه نرم ‌افزار مطابق هدایت آمر مربوطه .
وظایف مدیریتی:
رهنمایی تخنیکی تیم توسعه در خصوص معیارهای کد نویسی و طراحی سیستم ‌ها.
ارزیابی کیفیت کارهای تخنیکی انجام‌ شده در چارچوب پروژه ‌ها.
ترتیب و ارائه گزارش‌های تخنیکی و پیشرفت کار به آمر مربوطه.
وظایف هماهنگی:
هماهنگی با تیم ‌های تحلیل، تطبیق و نگهداری سیستم ‌ها.
تأمین هماهنگی با ادارات ذیربط در جریان انکشاف سیستم ‌های مالی به‌ منظور جلوگیری از نادرستی در درک پروسه ‌ها .
همکاری با کاربران و ذیربطین در رفع مشکلات تخنیکی سیستم‌ ها.
اشتراک در جلسات تخنیکی و کاری مرتبط با پروژه‌ های توسعه نرم‌افزار.
شرایط استخدام:
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد
سن وی از (۱۸) سال کمتر و از (۶۴) بیشتر نباشد.
سویه تحصیلی:
داشتن سند تحصیلی حد اقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته ‌های کمپیوتر ساینس، تکنالوژی معلوماتی، انجنیری نرم‌ افزار، سیستم‌ های معلوماتی یا سایر رشته‌ های تخنیکی مرتبط از مؤسسات تحصیلی ملی یا بین‌المللی داخل یا خارج کشور که به تأیید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد؛ به درجات تحصیلی بالاتر و داشتن اسناد تخصصی مرتبط ارجحیت داده می‌ شود.
تجربه کاری:
تجربه کاری حد اقل سه سال مرتبط به وظیفه
مهارت‌های لازم:
تسلط به مفاهیم توسعه نرم افزار و برنامه نویسی
مهارت تحلیل مشکلات تخنیکی سیستم ها
توانایی کار تیمی و هماهنگی تخنیکی
آشنایی با معیاری های کیفیت نرم افزار
تسلط به زبان های رسمی (دری، پشتو) و آشنایی با زبان انگلیسی

Submission Guideline
علاقمندان واجد شرایط می توانند که سی وی و درخواستی خویش را در یک فایل پی دی اف به ایمیل ادرس ذیل ارسال نمایند
نوت: لطف نموده درعنوان ایمیل خود نام بست و یا کود نمبر آنرا بنویسید ضم کردن اسناد تحصیلی، تجارب کاری و غیره فعلاً
ضرور نیست!

طراحی، ایجاد و مدیریت دیتابیس‌های مورد نیاز سیستم‌ ها .
تحلیل نیازمندی‌های دیتابیس و طراحی ساختار منطقی و فزیکی آن .

مدیریت و نظارت بر پروسه‌های Backup و Recovery
تطبیق تدابیر امنیتی جهت محافظت دیتابیس‌ها .
نظارت بر عملکرد دیتابیس ‌ها و بهتر سازی کارایی آنها (Performance Tuning) .
طرح و تطبیق پالیسی ‌ها، طرزالعمل ‌ها و کنترول ‌های امنیتی به منظور تأمین مصئونیت دیتابیس ‌ها و معلومات ذخیره‌ شده .
تحلیل و بهبود (Query) ها و (Index) ها و سایر اجزای دیتابیس به منظور افزایش سرعت و موثریت سیستم .

تشخیص و حل مشکلات تخنیکی دیتابیس ‌ها .

استفاده از ابزارهای نظارتی جهت بررسی کارایی و امنیت دیتابیس‌ها .
ارائه مشوره ‌های تخصصی به منظور حل مشکلات پیچیده دیتابیس .
آموزش و رهنمایی کارمندان مرتبط در امور دیتابیس .
رسیدگی به حوادث دیتابیس و بازیابی معلومات در صورت نیاز .
ترتیب راپورهای تخنیکی مرتبط به وضعیت دیتابیس‌ها .
انجام سایر وظایف تخنیکی مرتبط .

رهنمایی و نظارت تخنیکی بر کارکنان تحت اثر در امور دیتابیس .
کنترول کیفیت اجراآت تخنیکی مرتبط با دیتابیس .
مشارکت در ترتیب پلان‌های کاری بخش مربوطه .
ارائه گزارش‌ های منظم کاری و تخنیکی به ما فوق .

تأمین هماهنگی با تیم‌ های انکشاف نرم‌ افزار، سیستم‌ ها و امنیت معلومات .
همکاری با واحد های ذیربط جهت تحلیل نیازمندی ‌های معلوماتی .
هماهنگی در تطبیق تغییرات و اصلاحات دیتابیس‌ها .
تسهیل تبادل معلومات تخنیکی مرتبط با دیتابیس .

سن وی از (۱۸) سال کمتر و از (۶۴) بیشتر نباشد.

description:
Headquarters: U.S. Remote
About Flexport:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
What you'll do
There is no MSSP and no tier-1 queue here. Detection & Response engineers own their detections end to end: you write them, you tune them, and your team is paged when they fire. The security team is spread across the globe with a follow-the-sun pager rotation so nobody is paged at 3am local.
The adversaries are real. The business is growing fast and the threat surface is growing with it. Defining the necessary telemetry is part of the job.
Detection engineering
Build and tune detections across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud , treating them as software: version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and shipped through the same CI/CD practices the rest of engineering uses.
Track detection quality as measured quantities : coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, precision, time-to-detect. We don’t build-and-forget here.
Response & automation
Own incident response: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective that turns the incident into a systemic fix.
Build automation that removes toil from investigations, and partner closely with the US-based team so context carries across time zones instead of getting lost at handoff.
Telemetry & partnership
Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship , working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.
Threat hunt proactively across the estate , converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.
You Should Have
Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.
Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.
Practical incident response experience : you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.
Nice to have
Experience treating detections as code with CI/CD, peer review, and staged rollout.
Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship, rather than retrofitting logging after an incident.
A track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work - testing, source-checking, validation - rather than trusting agent output by default. If you haven’t already spotted the em dashes in this job description and already thought about where the hiring manager (hi!) has put hands on keyboard and compared that to where they let the LLM watermarks through, you might not be the right person for the job.
Familiarity with cloud-native and Kubernetes telemetry.
Experience with fraud or financial-crime detection patterns.
How we work
We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs.
We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

title: Engineering Manager, Platform Security
description:
Headquarters: Remote (West Coast)
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
More broadly, Discord is about empowering people to find belonging in all kinds of communities, and those people trust us to keep their communications safe. Our Platform Security Engineering team protects the systems we use to create Discord, making the “secure way” the “easy way.”
We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of software engineers in articulating and pursuing the most leveraged opportunities to reduce security risk across Engineering. This team will design and build lovable “paved paths” for managing identities and access, shipping code, configuring cloud infrastructure, and operating services. If you’re an Engineering Manager who’s deeply curious, eager to own technically and socially complex projects, and excited to improve security and privacy at Discord, read on!
What you'll do
You’ll shape company-wide security strategy and lead a highly-autonomous and horizontally-integrated team of software engineers who will...
Develop and apply best-in-class secure baselines for cloud infrastructure, owning the security of all cloud environments
Manage infrastructure vulnerabilities while supporting a high-velocity engineering org with hundreds of developers
Secure first- and third-party software supply chains, from the dev environment through CI/CD and into production
Build and operate identity and access management (IAM) systems for humans and machines that are user-friendly and promote least privilege
Consult on risk assessments, architectural designs, threat models, code reviews, and more—pragmatically balancing security with other business considerations
What we look for
3+ years of experience as people manager, having managed a team of 3+ security software engineers
Passion for creating diverse and inclusive teams and coaching engineers
3+ years of experience securing systems with millions of users
Comfort with writing the roadmap, not just following one
Experience building in and securing cloud-based environments (we use GCP, Cloudflare, and AWS)
Expert reasoning about the security of complex systems, even if they contain unfamiliar components
Experience writing software in a general-purpose programming language (we use Python, Typescript, and Rust)
Experience developing with agentic AI, and a good grasp of AI security practices
Bonus points if you have…
Understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts (e.g. RBAC, OAuth, Zero Trust network architectures, mTLS)
Familiarity with build and CI/CD technologies (e.g. Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite, Spacelift)
Experience defining and orchestrating containers (e.g. via Kubernetes, Docker, Distroless, OCI) and serverless workloads (e.g. Cloudflare Workers)
Experience with running and operationalizing security platforms such as Wiz
This position is West Coast (U.S.) based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.
The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
description:
Job Summary
Ramaki Group of Companies is seeking a qualified Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to define and execute the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap for its digital products and platforms. The role focuses on strategic leadership, secure and scalable infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and building a high-performing engineering team, all aligned with organizational business goals, customer needs, and industry standards.
The CTO will own the end-to-end technology function for Ramaki's fintech operations, from strategic planning and team development to vendor management and system reliability. The role combines strategic decision-making, cybersecurity oversight, regulatory and risk support, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration with the CEO, board, and compliance teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership and Decision-Making
• Define the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap in line with business goals.
• Work with the CEO and executive team on product, growth, and investment decisions.
• Lead, hire, and develop the engineering team across backend, frontend, mobile and UI/UX.
• Report on technology progress, risks, and budget to the board and investors.
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure
• Oversee the security approach and make sure security is built into the platform.
• Ensure infrastructure, customer data protection, backup, and disaster recovery meet business needs and payment security standards such as PCI DSS.
Regulatory, Risk and Compliance Support
• Work with Compliance and Risk teams so systems support EMI requirements such as safeguarding, KYC/AML and transaction monitoring.
• Support audits and regulator or partner reviews on technical matters.
Technology Innovation and Vendor Management
• Select and manage technology vendors and partners, such as payment processors, card providers, banking partners and KYC providers, and own the technology budget.
• Evaluate new technologies that improve efficiency, security or customer experience.
Systems and Service Availability and Reliability
• Ensure the platform is reliable, scalable and available, with accurate transaction processing, clear SLAs and monitoring.
• Establish engineering processes for development, testing, release, and incident management.

Job Requirements
• 7+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years in fintech.
• Led engineering teams of 10+ across backend, frontend, mobile, and design.
• Launched and ran a regulated payments, e-money, banking, or card product.
• Strong in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and secure engineering.
• Knowledge of EMI and payments regulation, KYC/AML and safeguarding.
• Clear communicator with the board, regulators and non-technical colleagues.

Submission Guideline
Interested applicants who meet the above-mentioned criteria are encouraged to send their CVs and a short note on a regulated product you have shipped to Hr@ramaki.co and clearly mention the job title and vacancy number in the subject line, such as (CTO, Vacancy #Ramaki-HRD-036); otherwise, their application will not be considered.
Submission email: Hr@ramaki.co

title: MSP Mac Help Desk Guru (work from home)
description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com
URL: https://ignitionit.com
Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first
TL;DR
ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.
We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.
What the actual job???
Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”
You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.
In a typical week, you might:
Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.
Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.
Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.
Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.
Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."
⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.
About ignitionit.com
We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!
What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.
We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

title: IT Manager / Managed IT Services (Open to Individuals & Companies)

description:
Job Summary
Position Summary: Ariana Medical Complex invites qualified individual IT professionals and eligible IT companies or service providers to apply for the management and support of the hospital’s information technology systems.
The selected individual or service provider will be responsible for planning, managing, maintaining, securing, and improving the hospital’s IT infrastructure and services. These services must support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational activities while ensuring system reliability, information security, confidentiality of patient data, and continuity of essential hospital services.
Applicants may apply under one of the following categories:
Category A – Individual IT Manager: An experienced IT professional responsible for managing the hospital’s IT operations and supervising the hospital’s IT staff.
Category B – IT Company / Service Provider: A qualified company that provides IT management services through a designated IT manager and an appropriately skilled technical team under an agreement with the hospital.
Key Responsibilities:
A. Strategic Leadership and IT Governance
Develop and implement an IT strategy aligned with the hospital’s objectives and healthcare service requirements.
Establish, review, and maintain IT policies, procedures, technical standards, and operational controls.
Advise hospital management on technology investments, digital transformation, system improvements, and IT-related risks.
Develop an annual IT work plan, including priorities, resource requirements, maintenance schedules, and improvement activities.
Ensure IT operations support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational departments.
B. IT Operations and Infrastructure
Manage and maintain servers, computer networks, databases, applications, workstations, printers, scanners, switches, cameras, and related equipment.
Ensure the availability, performance, reliability, and proper functioning of critical hospital IT systems.
Manage network architecture, routing, connectivity, wireless networks, internet services, email systems, and internal communications.
Coordinate installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of IT equipment.
Maintain an updated inventory of IT equipment, software, licenses, systems, and related assets.
Minimize service interruptions and coordinate timely resolution of technical problems.
C. Information Security and Data Protection
Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of hospital information and patient records.
Implement appropriate access controls, user account management, password policies, endpoint protection, and security monitoring.
Establish and maintain regular data backup, restoration testing, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
Monitor and address cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, unauthorized access, malware, and other security incidents.
Ensure that access to patient information is restricted to authorized personnel and permitted purposes.
Report significant security incidents promptly to the designated hospital authority.
Ensure that hospital data is not copied, transferred, disclosed, or used without proper authorization.
D. Systems Development and Improvement
Assess, recommend, install, configure, and maintain suitable hardware, software, and technology solutions.
Support the effective operation and improvement of hospital information systems, including clinical, administrative, financial, and other approved platforms.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend cost-effective solutions that improve hospital services.
Coordinate system upgrades, software updates, equipment replacement, and technical projects.
Ensure that changes to critical systems are properly authorized, documented, tested, and implemented.
E. IT Support and Team Management
Provide or coordinate timely technical support to all hospital departments.
Supervise, guide, and evaluate hospital IT staff, where applicable.
Ensure proper allocation of IT duties, technical coverage, staff development, and performance monitoring.
Establish a system for receiving, recording, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving IT support requests.
Provide advanced technical assistance for complex IT and system-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical coverage for critical hospital services, including agreed arrangements for urgent and after-hours support.
F. Budget, Procurement, and Vendor Management
Prepare or contribute to the annual IT budget, equipment replacement plan, and maintenance requirements.
Recommend cost-effective procurement of IT equipment, software, licenses, and technical services.
Coordinate with authorized hospital departments regarding procurement specifications, vendor evaluation, and technical acceptance.
Manage technical relationships with internet providers, software vendors, equipment suppliers, and other service providers.
Monitor vendor performance, warranties, service agreements, licenses, and maintenance commitments.
Ensure that procurement and expenditure recommendations are submitted through the hospital’s approved authorization procedures.
G. Compliance, Documentation, and Reporting
Ensure compliance with hospital policies, applicable regulations, accreditation requirements, and approved information security procedures.
Maintain updated technical documentation, network diagrams, system configurations, equipment inventories, access records, and maintenance logs.
Prepare regular reports covering system availability, support requests, incidents, cybersecurity risks, completed activities, and proposed improvements.
Report major risks, service disruptions, resource gaps, and unresolved technical issues to the designated hospital authority.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by hospital leadership within the approved scope of work.
2. Confidentiality and Ownership of Hospital Information
The selected individual or company must:
Sign the required confidentiality and data protection undertaking before receiving access to hospital systems or information.
Use hospital data and systems solely for authorized purposes.
Maintain appropriate safeguards for patient information, employee records, financial information, and other confidential hospital data.
Refrain from retaining, disclosing, transferring, or using hospital information after termination of the engagement, except where expressly authorized or legally required.
Ensure that all hospital data, configurations, documentation, credentials, and other hospital-owned information remain under the hospital’s control.
Return hospital property and transfer all required records, documentation, credentials, and system access arrangements upon termination or completion of the assignment.
3. Deliverables and Performance Indicators
The selected individual or company will be expected to provide the following deliverables according to an agreed implementation schedule:
No.
Deliverable
Performance Indicator
1
Initial IT assessment and improvement plan
Assessment and prioritized action plan submitted and approved
2
IT asset and system inventory
Inventory maintained and updated
3
IT maintenance plan
Preventive maintenance conducted and documented
4
IT support and incident management
Requests recorded, tracked, and handled within agreed service levels
5
Data backup and recovery plan
Backups monitored and restoration tests documented
6
Information security measures
Access controls reviewed and security incidents reported
7
IT documentation
Essential technical documentation maintained and updated
8
Periodic performance reports
Reports submitted according to the agreed reporting schedule
9
Annual IT plan and budget recommendations
Submitted within the timeline approved by hospital management
10
Handover and continuity arrangements
Complete handover completed at the end of the engagement
Specific uptime targets, response times, resolution targets, and other service-level indicators shall be agreed upon in the contract or service agreement, taking into account the hospital’s operational requirements and available resources.

Job Requirements
4. Additional Requirements for Individual Applicants
Individual applicants must meet the following minimum requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. A master’s degree is an advantage.
At least five years of progressively responsible IT experience, including at least two years in a supervisory or managerial role.
Experience in server administration, network management, cybersecurity, backup systems, disaster recovery, and IT support.
Experience managing enterprise-level infrastructure; experience in a hospital or other healthcare institution is an advantage.
Strong leadership, planning, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
High professional integrity and commitment to confidentiality and data protection.
Fluency in Dari, Pashto, and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in the languages required for the assignment.
Ability to provide the services and meet the attendance, availability, and reporting requirements agreed with the hospital.
5. Additional Requirements for IT Companies / Service Providers
Companies applying for this assignment must provide evidence of their ability to deliver reliable IT management services in a hospital environment.
Minimum requirements include:
Valid business registration and authorization to provide IT-related services under applicable Afghan laws and regulations.
Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure management, technical support, networking, cybersecurity, systems maintenance, or related services.
A company profile describing its technical capabilities, service coverage, organizational structure, and relevant experience.
Evidence of previous relevant assignments, including client references or completion certificates where available.
A proposed service delivery team, including a designated IT Manager or Team Leader and appropriately qualified technical personnel.
CVs, educational qualifications, and relevant experience records for key personnel assigned to the hospital.
A technical proposal explaining the proposed management approach, service delivery arrangements, support coverage, escalation procedures, backup strategy, cybersecurity measures, and reporting arrangements.
A proposed service-level arrangement specifying response times, resolution targets, system monitoring, preventive maintenance, and emergency support.
A financial proposal detailing professional fees, staffing costs, maintenance charges, and any additional costs, clearly identifying applicable exclusions.
Written acceptance of the hospital’s confidentiality, patient data protection, access control, and information security requirements.
The company shall nominate a qualified person to serve as its primary contact and IT Manager for the assignment. Replacement of key personnel must be subject to prior approval by the hospital.
6. Evaluation and Selection Criteria
Applications will be evaluated according to the applicant category.
For individual applicants:
Educational qualifications and relevant certifications.
Years and relevance of IT management experience.
Technical competence and problem-solving ability.
Leadership and communication skills.
Healthcare or comparable enterprise IT experience.
Proposed approach to managing the hospital’s IT operations.
For companies / service providers:
Legal registration and eligibility.
Relevant company experience and past performance.
Qualifications and experience of the proposed IT Manager and technical team.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Availability, support coverage, cybersecurity, and continuity arrangements.
Financial proposal and overall value for money.
Ariana Medical Complex reserves the right to verify submitted documents, contact references, conduct interviews or technical assessments, request clarification, and select the applicant that best meets the hospital’s requirements, subject to its approved procedures.
7. Contractual and Administrative Arrangements
Individual applicants, if selected, shall enter into an employment or individual service contract, as determined by the hospital.
Companies, if selected, shall enter into a service agreement defining the scope of services, deliverables, staffing arrangements, service levels, payment terms, confidentiality obligations, performance monitoring, and termination conditions.
The final scope, contract duration, payment structure, working arrangements, and reporting requirements shall be agreed upon and approved by the hospital before commencement.
No applicant may access hospital systems or patient information before the required authorization and confidentiality arrangements are in place.
The hospital retains authority over strategic decisions, procurement approvals, system access authorization, and other reserved management functions.

Submission Guideline
8. Application Procedure
Interested individuals and eligible companies may submit their applications quoting the Job tile and the Vacancy Announcement Number (AMC | HRD-897) in the subject line to email.
Individual applicants should submit:
Updated CV.
Application letter.
Copies of educational certificates and relevant professional certifications.
Evidence of relevant work experience.
A brief technical approach to managing hospital IT services.
Fluency in English, Dari, and Pashto (spoken and written).
Companies / service providers should submit:
Company profile and valid registration documents.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Relevant contracts, references, or evidence of previous assignments.
CVs and qualifications of the proposed IT Manager and key technical personnel.
Proposed service-level arrangements and support coverage.
Detailed financial proposal.
Applications that do not include the required documents by November 30, 2026 or fail to mention the Vacancy Announcement Number and Job Title in the subject line will not be considered.

title: ICT and HMIS Officer
category: Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Management
description:
Role Summary
Ummat International Hospital is seeking a qualified, motivated, and responsible ICT and HMIS Officer to provide general information technology support and ensure the effective management, monitoring, and utilization of the hospital's Hospital Management Information System (HMIS).
The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the hospital's IT infrastructure, computers, software, network connectivity, and other IT equipment. In addition, the officer will oversee the daily operation and effective use of the existing HMIS, provide technical support to users, monitor data quality, and train hospital staff on the proper use of the system.

Duties and Responsibilities
A. Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
Provide routine technical support for computers, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment used within the hospital.
Troubleshoot basic hardware, software, operating system, and network connectivity issues.
Assist with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of authorized software and IT equipment.
Support internet connectivity and local area network (LAN) operations and coordinate with service providers to resolve major technical issues.
Assist hospital staff with common IT-related problems and provide basic guidance on the appropriate use of IT equipment and applications.
Maintain an inventory of IT equipment and keep records of technical issues, repairs, and maintenance activities.
Support the implementation of basic IT security practices, including antivirus updates, appropriate user access, and secure handling of digital information.
Assist with routine data backup and recovery procedures in coordination with the relevant technical personnel.
Report major IT issues and recommend practical solutions to ensure uninterrupted hospital operations.
B. Hospital Management Information System (HMIS)
Manage, monitor, and support the daily operation and effective utilization of the hospital's existing HMIS.
Ensure that relevant hospital departments use the HMIS correctly and consistently in their daily activities.
Provide training, guidance, and ongoing technical support to hospital staff on the proper use of the HMIS.
Monitor the accuracy, completeness, and timely entry of information into the system.
Identify HMIS-related technical and operational problems, resolve issues within the scope of responsibility, and coordinate with the relevant technical team or service provider when necessary.
Monitor HMIS user accounts and access permissions in accordance with assigned roles and responsibilities.
Support the generation, review, and preparation of hospital reports using information available in the HMIS.
Coordinate with relevant hospital departments to improve data quality, reporting practices, and compliance with established HMIS procedures.
Maintain the confidentiality, security, and appropriate handling of patient information and other hospital data.
Monitor HMIS availability and performance, document recurring problems, and report system limitations to the relevant supervisor or service provider.
Identify gaps in HMIS utilization and recommend practical measures to improve system use and operational efficiency.
Maintain records of HMIS-related issues, user support activities, training sessions, and system maintenance.
Support HMIS users in following established procedures for patient registration, appointments, medical records, billing, and other relevant hospital functions, according to the system's available modules.

Job Requirements
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor's degree in information and communication technology (ICT), Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, or a related field.
Good knowledge of computer hardware, software, operating systems, networking, and general IT troubleshooting.
Practical experience in managing, monitoring, or operating a Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) is highly preferred.
Previous experience working in a hospital or healthcare facility will be an advantage.
Ability to provide technical support and train staff with different levels of computer literacy.
Good understanding of data quality, information security, user access control, and patient data confidentiality.
Ability to prepare basic technical records and support the generation of HMIS reports.
Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with different hospital departments.
Required Competencies
HMIS operation, management, and monitoring.
HMIS user support and staff training.
Data quality monitoring and reporting.
Information security and confidentiality.
Communication, coordination, and teamwork.

Submission Guidelines
Qualified candidates who meet the above-mentioned requirements are invited to submit their applications through the Jobs.af online application system.
If you encounter any issues submitting your application through this platform, you may forward your CV to ( ayass.habibi@ummathospital.com ) as an alternative.
The exact position title must be clearly indicated in the email subject line.
Applications must include:
An updated Curriculum Vitae (CV)
A cover letter
The CV and cover letter must be combined and submitted as one PDF file. The PDF file must be named using the applicant’s full name, as shown below:
Example: Ahmad_Ahmadi_CV_and_Cover_Letter.pdf
Incomplete applications, applications submitted in an incorrect format, or applications received after the closing date may not be considered.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further assessment and interviews.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Role Summary
The Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, deploying, and supporting MOAM’s web, backend, and mobile applications. The role requires strong hands-on experience with .NET Core backend development and microservice architecture, Next.js frontend development, Flutter mobile development, and the infrastructure required to run these systems reliably in production.
The position will contribute to the design, development, and evolution of MOAM’s digital logistics ecosystem, including Courier and Cargo products across web and mobile platforms, shared backend services, system integrations, and future digital solutions, with responsibility spanning APIs, distributed services, caching, messaging, observability, databases, containerization, server administration, security, performance, and third-party integrations. The developer is expected to work across the complete software delivery lifecycle and collaborate closely with the Technology Unit and business stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities
A. Backend Development & Microservices
· Design, develop, maintain, and optimize backend services and REST APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core / .NET Core.
· Design services using microservice architecture, clear service boundaries, maintainable domain/application layers, and clean architecture principles.
· Implement authentication, authorization, role/permission management, API validation, error handling, background processing, and secure service-to-service communication.
· Work with SQL Server and relational data access using Entity Framework Core; design efficient schemas, migrations, indexes, transactions, and queries.
· Implement distributed caching and cache invalidation strategies using Redis or equivalent technologies.
· Use RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging, event-driven workflows, queues, retries, and reliable communication between services; implement real-time application features using appropriate technologies such as SignalR/WebSockets where required.
· Integrate MOAM systems with ERP (including Sage), CRM, payment gateways, SMS/notification services, Firebase, customs systems, and other internal or third-party platforms.
B. Frontend Development
· Develop and maintain responsive, secure, production-ready web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
· Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, authentication flows, real-time features, and server-side/client-side data fetching as appropriate.
· Build reusable UI components, handle application state effectively, and ensure performance, accessibility, maintainability, and cross-browser compatibility.
C. Mobile Application Development
· Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
· Integrate Flutter applications with .NET APIs and Firebase services such as Cloud Messaging/push notifications, authentication, analytics, or other required Firebase capabilities.
· Manage mobile application state, API communication, error handling, local persistence, release builds, and application performance.
D. DevOps, Server & Deployment Management
· Containerize applications and supporting services using Docker and Docker Compose; maintain reliable environment configuration across development, staging, and production.
· Administer and troubleshoot application servers, preferably Linux-based environments, including services, networking, ports, SSL/TLS certificates, reverse proxies such as Nginx, storage, permissions, and resource usage.
· Support CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, environment variables/secrets, deployment automation, backups, rollback procedures, and production releases.
· Monitor application and infrastructure health and diagnose production issues across services, containers, databases, logs, queues, caches, and network dependencies.
E. Logging, Monitoring & Reliability
· Implement structured application logging using Serilog and centralized log monitoring/analysis using Seq.
· Design meaningful logs, correlation identifiers, health checks, metrics, alerts, and diagnostics to support distributed systems and production troubleshooting.
· Improve application performance, scalability, resilience, fault handling, and availability through profiling, testing, and operational monitoring.
F. Quality, Security & Engineering Practices
· Write unit and integration tests and perform API, frontend, and mobile validation before release.
· Apply secure coding practices for authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection, input validation, dependency management, and API security.
· Participate in technical design, sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, Git workflows, troubleshooting, and documentation.
· Produce clear technical documentation for architecture, APIs, deployments, integrations, and operational procedures.

Job Requirements
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
· Strong professional experience building full-stack production applications, with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core as the primary backend technology.
· Hands-on experience with microservices, REST APIs, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, Redis caching, RabbitMQ messaging, Serilog, and Seq.
· Hands-on experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
· Hands-on experience developing mobile applications with Flutter/Dart and integrating Firebase services.
· Practical experience with Docker/containerization, Git, server administration, application deployment, and production troubleshooting.
· Good understanding of software architecture, security, performance, scalability, concurrency, testing, and distributed-system fundamentals.
· Ability to independently analyze technical problems, communicate clearly, document solutions, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
· Good command of English for technical documentation and communication; Dari and/or Pashto are advantageous.
Preferred / Advantageous Experience
· API gateways/reverse proxies (for example YARP or Nginx), CQRS/Mediator patterns, background workers, scheduled jobs, and distributed tracing.
· CI/CD platforms, cloud or VPS environments, DNS/SSL management, backups, monitoring, and production incident response.
· Experience integrating ERP/CRM, logistics, warehouse, cargo, payment, notification, or other enterprise systems.
· Experience with Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, automated testing, code quality tools, and Agile/Scrum delivery.

Submission Guidelines
Please send your CV and a brief cover letter to careers@moamlogistics.com . All documents should be submitted in PDF format , with the file name clearly indicating your first and last name and the position applied for . Please note that interviews may be conducted while the position remains open and under announcement .

: comfortable reading and changing an Express service

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group .
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.
Profile Overview
This is the hard end of web scraping. The sites we rely on, Google, Amazon, Walmart and many others, actively work to block us, and they change the rules without warning. We're looking for a senior engineer who can go deep on why we're being blocked, work out how the detection actually functions, and design repeatable ways around it. You'll be joining a self-driven, high-autonomy team to take on our most involved problems, with the room and the trust to build something from close to a blank page: an environment that turns one-off breakthroughs into a methodical, repeatable way of defeating anti-bot systems. If you like confronting problems that genuinely resist you, and you work methodically rather than by trial and error, this is an unusually open brief.
Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:
Getting a full local environment running and becoming fluent in our systems and how they operate, in the first few weeks.
Contributing to a proposal on the design for a repeatable environment we can pose anti-bot problems to and get reliable analysis out of.
Building that environment out over the following months so that, by month six, we can point it at a target or provider and have it reliably tell us how we're being blocked and what is and isn't being used against us.
Your responsibilities
Analyse how specific anti-bot and bot-mitigation systems (the likes of DataDome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada, PerimeterX and Akamai) detect and block us, and design systems to work around them.
Turn isolated breakthroughs into durable, repeatable processes: hypothesis, test, discard what's wrong, move on.
In collaboration with other senior team members, design and build a greenfield agentic environment that can propose and run tests on anti-bot behaviour and bypass approaches, and do it in a way that's well understood and repeatable.
Work largely independently on deep, concentrated problems, while actively pulling in knowledge from across the wider engineering team.
Communicate clearly what you plan to do, and step into major incidents when the team needs your depth.
What you bring to the table
Deep, genuine understanding of how the internet works underneath: HTTP, TLS and fingerprinting, proxies, headers, cookies, and browser behaviour. This is the core of the role and it isn't something we can shortcut.
Excellent problem-solving built on a scientific, methodical approach: you form a hypothesis, design a test, read the result honestly, and iterate. Trying things at random is the opposite of what this role needs.
Strong hands-on skills in our stack, Node.js and TypeScript with solid Python, and comfort across backend systems at scale (Postgres, Redis/Valkey, MongoDB, Puppeteer/Camoufox, Kubernetes).
Real skill at directing AI coding agents with precision, and the judgement to tell strong output from weak. The specific tool doesn't matter (Claude, Codex or similar); knowing how to steer it well is what counts.
A background that has given you this kind of depth and rigour. That might be scraping, anti-bot or web-security work, reverse engineering, or a research or academic path where you built your own tooling and lived by the scientific method. Direct scraping experience is a strong plus rather than a strict requirement.
Independence and strong communication: you're comfortable owning hard problems in a remote-first team with little hand-holding, and you keep the team in the loop on your thinking as you go.

title: DevSecOps Engineer Internship
description:
Overview: Securing the CI/CD Pipeline
The DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for automating, integrating, and enforcing security controls throughout the entire development lifecycle, from code commit to production deployment. You will be the vital link between Development, Security, and Operations, ensuring that the continuous integration and delivery pipelines for our e-commerce platform, internal tools, and AI agents are secure by design.
Internship Details
Duration: 3 months
Start Date: Immediate
Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.
Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will embed security into the automation processes across the entire tech stack.
Security Automation (CI/CD): Integrate automated security scanning tools, including Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), directly into our CI/CD pipelines (managed via Makefile and automated testing pipelines).
Infrastructure Security: Enforce secure Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform for provisioning and managing our Oracle Cloud Free VMs. Continuously monitor the cloud infrastructure for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
Container and Runtime Security: Manage and secure the application deployment environment by implementing robust container security policies for Docker and ensuring runtime threat detection and logging for production services.
Collaboration & Remediation: Collaborate directly with development teams to promote secure coding practices, provide guidance on vulnerability remediation, and ensure security findings are addressed before deployment.
Secrets Management: Implement automated injection and rotation of secrets using Vault into the applications and deployment environment.
Observability Integration: Integrate security logs and metrics into the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki) to ensure real-time security monitoring and alerting.
Required Technologies & Tools
Candidates must have strong hands-on experience in both DevOps automation and security implementation:
Automation/CI/CD: Makefile, automated testing, scripting (Bash/Python/Node.js).
Security Tools: SAST/DAST tools, vulnerability scanners, runtime protection.
